ektachrome400.name: Kodak Ektachrome 400
ektachrome400.notes: SpektraFilm supplies Ektachrome 100, NOT Ektachrome 400. Historical Ektachrome 400X (E-161) exists but must not be silently selected as a specific 400 stock/version; source sensitometric data first, then implement and validate actual 400 reversal profile. Do not substitute E100.

trix400.name: Kodak Tri-X 400
trix400.notes: Requires Kodak Tri-X 400 negative measured model and monochrome print/scanner pipeline; not Kodak Tri-X reversal 7266. Do not simulate by renaming a monochrome preset.

aerocolor_iv.name: Kodak AeroColor IV 2460
aerocolor_iv.notes: Kodak AS-2652 PDF contains spectral sensitivity, spectral dye density, and contrast curves; AeroColor IV is unmasked aerial negative with process-dependent behavior. Must digitize and validate profile prior to rendering.
